directSimulationTitle: ACS Reactions: They Changed Coke and Didn't Tell Anyone
directSimulationStudentTask: After the ACS article opens, stay on this exact page and use the article section under the title. Read the paragraph that begins with the claim about Mexican Coke and the challenge from chemistry professors. Observe how the article connects a chemistry claim to lab testing, instruments, sources, and evidence. Record the chemistry claim, the evidence source named in the article, one source-quality feature, and whether the claim is supported. Write a CER conclusion that explains how the article's evidence supports or challenges the real-world chemistry claim.
simulationReviewImplementation: Student-facing lesson includes one exact direct simulation/resource link plus adjacent step-by-step directions for what to open, click/use, observe, record, and connect to the lesson standard.
